# ezghcloud_dns_zone (Data Source)

Read an existing EZGH DNS zone by its ID or its domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Domain name of the zone. Set id or domain.
- `id` (String) Zone ID (zon_). Set id or domain.

### Read-Only

- `dnssec_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the zone is signed with DNSSEC.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Nameservers to delegate the domain to.
- `status` (String) pending until the zone's ownership is verified, then active.
- `tags` (Map of String) Zone tags.
- `verification` (Attributes) The TXT record that proves control of the domain while the zone is pending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification))

<a id="nestedatt--verification"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verification`

Read-Only:

- `txt_name` (String) TXT record name.
- `txt_value` (String) TXT record value.
